subject: MAP: weekly checkpoint cadence & owner roster
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@cloudscale.com>, CloudScale Procurement <procure@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: weekly checkpoint cadence & owner roster

Hi Elena and team,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, I put together a lightweight cadence to keep the MAP momentum going and to make the evaluation timeline predictable. Attaching the working MAP and the evaluation checklist.

Proposed weekly checkpoint (30 minutes):
- Cadence: Wednesdays, 9:00–9:30 AM PT
- Purpose: quick status, surface blockers, confirm next-week priorities, and update the success criteria tracker
- Attendees (core): Elena (CloudScale), Alex (Redwood, lead), Marissa (Redwood, CS owner), Ben (Redwood, solutions)

Initial success criteria to monitor (we'll refine):
1) Latency SLO: P95 inference < 250ms for 512-token requests
2) Cost: projected per-1k-token cost within agreed budget range
3) Functional: top-3 prompt scenarios return acceptable quality in at least 90% of samples in the eval set

Immediate action items for this week:
- Alex: Share the first MAP spreadsheet and set up the recurring calendar invite (see attachment)
- Marissa: Prepare evaluation prompts and baseline metrics by Tue EOD PT
- Elena: Share a short list of privacy/compliance constraints to seed the security questionnaire

Please confirm the cadence and attendees, or suggest alternate times. If this works for you, I'll schedule the recurring invite and include a simple agenda template.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: cloudscale_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), evaluation_checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Elena Soto <elena@cloudscale.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudScale Procurement <procure@cloudscale.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: weekly checkpoint cadence & owner roster

Thanks, Alex — this looks good.

Wednesday 9 AM PT works for our core team (I can bring the Product lead if we need deeper prompt feedback some weeks). I'll get procurement's list of contractual must-haves to you by Friday.

For success criteria, can we add: model determinism metric (stability across 5 seeds) and a throughput checkpoint (tokens/sec at 95% CPU/GPU utlization)? Those matter for our production SLA planning.

I confirm: the CloudScale attendees for now will be myself and Procurement (procure@cloudscale.com). Please include a brief section in the agenda for compliance items.

—Elena
CTO, CloudScale Systems
elena@cloudscale.com
